note: the glow and shadow mask is read at y plus dy instead of y minus dy, so a drop shadow with positive dy moves up, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.shadowMovesDown
the inner glow and shadow are not clipped by the layer alpha, so an inner shadow paints the transparent pixels around the shape, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.innerStaysInside
the glow ignores its intensity, so every nonzero intensity glows as 1, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.intensityScalesGlow
the glow and shadow blur by reach over six instead of reach over three, so a glow reaches half its radius, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.glowReachesItsRadius
the light mask is padded one pixel whatever the offset, so an offset cannot pull in blur that spilled past the edge, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.offsetPullsInBlurPastTheEdge
the inner glow and shadow darken the layer by the mask cover instead of the light's alpha, so a clear inner shadow changes the layer, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.intensityZeroIsIdentity

the stroke measures to edge pixel centres instead of the sub-pixel anti-aliased edge point, so a partly covered edge column is measured from its centre, caught by AlphaEffectTests.strokeMeasuresAntiAliasedEdge
anchor: let d = g > 0 ? Self.edgeOffset(alpha: v, abs(gx) / g, abs(gy) / g) / g : 0

note: the edge offset drops its corner branch for the linear one, so a diagonal edge pixel of low alpha puts the edge too far out, caught by AlphaEffectTests.strokeMeasuresDiagonalAntiAliasedEdge
anchor: if alpha < a1 { return 0.5 * (u + v) - (2 * u * v * alpha).squareRoot() }
replacement: if alpha < a1 { return (0.5 - alpha) * u }

note: the padded work size adds the pad once instead of on both sides, so a stroke, glow or shadow too large to pad passes the guard and its error names the wrong size, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.paddedWorkSizePadsBothSides (and tooLargeToPadNamesTheEffect stops at its require before the slow shadow)
anchor: let pw = width + 2 * pad, ph = height + 2 * pad
replacement: let pw = width + pad, ph = height + pad

note: the light too-large error always blames the blur and the offset, so a shadow whose offset alone sets the padding tells the caller to reduce the blur, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.tooLargeNamesOnlyWhatSetsThePadding
anchor: guard reach + 3 < offset else { return (pad, effect + at, "offset") }
replacement: guard true else { return (pad, effect + at, "offset") }

note: the stroke skips the padded work size check, so a stroke whose padded copy passes the work limit allocates it instead of throwing, caught by AlphaEffectTests.strokePaddingPastTheLimitThrows
anchor: let (pw, ph) = try Self.paddedWorkSize(width: width, height: height, pad: 1, cause: "stroke", remedy: nil)

note: the glow and shadow skip the padded work size check, so a mask whose padded copy passes the work limit is allocated instead of throwing, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.glowPaddingPastTheLimitThrows and shadowPaddingPastTheLimitThrows
anchor: let (pw, ph) = try Self.paddedWorkSize(width: width, height: height, pad: pad, cause: cause, remedy: remedy)

note: the padded work size limit is loosened by a row, so a stroke, glow or shadow copy one pixel past the limit passes, caught by the PaddingPastTheLimitThrows tests
the stroke's too-large error blames the width again, though its one-pixel padding is fixed and only the buffer sets it, caught by AlphaEffectTests.strokePaddingPastTheLimitThrows
